about: Which of a dispatch's orders get folded into one Combined Order per customer. Replaced 'Close the week' on 20 August 2026: a week was never something the customer received, a van is. ONLY THE DASHBOARD IMPLEMENTS THIS - the phone's own weekly combine was deleted in the same commit, so this file is read by client/ only. That is deliberate and recorded in ../DIVERGENCES.md; do not 'fix' the phone by adding a second way to combine.

fields.note: Membership lives ONLY on Sales Order.custom_combined_order, a single Link - an order can be in at most one group. Combined Order.custom_dispatch was added 20 Aug 2026; week_start/week_end were relaxed from mandatory to optional the same day and are left empty by dispatch-made groups.

rules.complete_only: An order is grouped only by the dispatch that leaves NOTHING outstanding on it. A part-loaded order waits for the van that clears its remainder and joins that group instead - because custom_combined_order holds one link, so an order carried by two dispatches could otherwise only point at one, and whichever wrote second would move it out of a group whose count and total then said something untrue.
rules.two_or_more: A group is made only where a customer has two or more eligible orders. One order is not a combination; grouping it alone hands the rep a second identifier for something that already had one. The old weekly close made exactly those pointless groups of one.
rules.never_moved: An order already in a group is left alone. It belongs to the dispatch that completed it, and that has already happened.

plan.why: the case the feature exists for: two of one customer's orders finish on the same van, so the customer received one delivery and sees one order
one order alone is not a combination - it keeps its own identity rather than gaining a second one
a part-loaded order is not grouped by this van: 7 of 10 rolls went, so the order is not finished and must stay free to join the dispatch that clears the other 3
two customers on one van are two separate deliveries and two separate groups - a combined order is per customer, never per van
an order already in a group is never moved into a newer one - it belongs to the dispatch that completed it, and the older group's count and total must stay true
excluding the already-grouped one can drop a customer below two, and then no group is made at all rather than one of one
three of one customer's orders finishing together are one group of three, and the total is their sum - this is what the rep quotes when the customer rings
an order with no customer cannot be grouped by customer, and must be skipped rather than gathered under a blank key - Frappe reads an unset Link back as null, '' or the string 'null'
money is rounded to paise on the group total, so a sum of thirds does not carry a floating-point tail into what the customer is told they owe
a van that finished nothing makes no groups at all - every order on it is still part-owed
